172	/-! ### Planar vectors: dot product and perpendicular bracket -/
173	
174	/-- The scattering plane (CM frame): `R^2` with its standard inner product. -/
175	abbrev Plane := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)
176	
177	/-- Dot product of two planar vectors. -/
178	def dot (v w : Plane) : ℝ := v 0 * w 0 + v 1 * w 1
179	
180	/-- Planar perpendicular bracket `perp v w = v_x w_y - v_y w_x`: the signed
181	z-component of the 2D cross product.  Positive when `w` is reached from `v`
182	by a counterclockwise rotation of less than 180 degrees.  Used to express
183	angular momentum and the side (branch/orientation) of the deflection. -/
184	def perp (v w : Plane) : ℝ := v 0 * w 1 - v 1 * w 0

662	    funext s

3206	trigonometry: `arccos (-x) = π - arccos x`,
3207	`arccos x = π/2 - arcsin x`, and `arcsin x = arctan (x / sqrt (1-x²))`
3208	for `x = 1/eps ∈ (0, 1)` (`eps > 1` from `eccentricity_gt_one`), with
3209	the square-root algebra `sqrt (1 - 1/eps²) = sqrt (eps²-1) / eps`.  No

3211	deflection formula from the geometric bridges. -/
3212	theorem asymptote_angle_eq_arctan (hμ : IsAngularMomentumFactor unboundMu) :

3214	      Real.arctan (1 / Real.sqrt (S.eccentricitySq - 1)) := by
3215	  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) < S.eccentricitySq := eccentricity_gt_one S hμ
3216	  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < S.eccentricitySq := by linarith
3217	  have heps_pos : (0 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt S.eccentricitySq := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
3218	  have heps_gt : (1 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt S.eccentricitySq := by
3219	    rw [show (1 : ℝ) = Real.sqrt 1 from (Real.sqrt_one).symm]
3220	    exact Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (by norm_num) h1
3221	  have hpos1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / Real.sqrt S.eccentricitySq := one_div_pos.mpr heps_pos
3222	  have hmem : (1 / Real.sqrt S.eccentricitySq) ∈ Set.Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 := by

3224	    rw [div_lt_one heps_pos]
3225	    exact heps_gt

3284	        (Real.sqrt (2 * S.total_energy / S.reduced_mass) •
3285	          dirVec (S.polar_angle 0 -
3286	            Real.arccos (-1 / Real.sqrt S.eccentricitySq))) =
